name: Open a new share
description: Opens a new share of a given type for a member with an initial deposit, through the review screen and posting it. Returns the confirmation number and the new share id.

inputParams.name: shareType
inputParams.description: Share type code: S0001 (Regular), S0070 (Share Draft), MMKT (Money Market), CERT (Certificate).

outputs.name: confirmationNumber
outputs.description: Extract the confirmation number from the success screen

outputs.name: newShareId
outputs.description: Extract the new share identifier from the success screen
